_readme: Known engine yaw values for the Add a game screen. Only widely documented engine constants belong here. yaw = degrees turned per mouse count at sensitivity 1. fovType is optional and only set where the engine's FOV number is well known.

presets.name: Source / Source 2
presets.examples: Counter-Strike, Team Fortress 2, Apex Legends, Titanfall, Half-Life, Left 4 Dead, Portal

presets.name: Quake / id Tech 3
presets.examples: Quake Live, Quake III, older Call of Duty (CoD 4, MW2 2009, Black Ops 1)

presets.name: Call of Duty (2019 and later)
presets.examples: Modern Warfare 2019 onward, Warzone, Black Ops Cold War and later
